MAXCA: Multi-axis Cross-covariance Attention for Deformable Medical Image Registration

Multi-axis Cross-covariance Attention for Deformable Medical Image Registration Deformable image registration, aiming to establish a pixel-wise non-linear spatial correspondence between images, is a fundamental step in medical image analysis. Transformers have been widely used in deep learning-based registration methods for the ability to capture long-range dependencies. However, the high computation/memory loads of self-attention hinder transformers from processing subtle textural infor-mation in high-resolution image features, e.g., at the full/half image resolutions.
